q: By the end of June 2027, a major South Korean chipmaker officially announces a production cut or disruption due to a helium shortage, or such a disruption is reported by major media
basis: Even while Qatar's helium production was halted for several months in 2026, no production disruptions at South Korean chipmakers were reported (thanks to inventories, recycling, and diversified sourcing). Qatari helium began shipping via Jeddah in August. Samsung Electronics and SK hynix hold four to six months of helium inventory. If this forecast comes true, it would signal that the assessment that a helium shortage amounts to no more than a cost burden was wrong · The AI variable in the Iran issue
